name: DRC (Dexamethasone / Rituximab / Cyclophosphamide) - Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia
histology: lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma with IgM monoclonal paraprotein; CD19+, CD20+, surface IgM+

biomarkers.note: DRC is a fixed-duration chemoimmunotherapy backbone that does not depend on MYD88/CXCR4 genotype (genotype guides BTK-inhibitor selection instead). Per DeVita 12th ed. lines 267635 to 267639 and Standard Guidelines (NCCN), WM/LPL, v1.2027.

lineOfTherapy: an other-recommended chemoimmunotherapy option for primary and previously treated WM/LPL; a non-neuropathic, non-BTKi alternative (overall response ~83%)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: for high IgM / hyperviscosity, plasmapheresis before rituximab or initial rituximab withholding to avoid IgM flare
eligibilityCriteria.source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22nd ed.

drugs.name: Dexamethasone

provenance.locator: Cyclophosphamide/Dexamethasone + Rituximab as a recommended regimen (extract lines 485, 517)

drugs.notes: DOSE NOT ESTABLISHED IN THE PROVIDED SOURCES -> VERIFY. Dexamethasone is the corticosteroid component of DRC; the provided NCCN extract and DeVita/Harrison do not print a dexamethasone mg dose for WM DRC. The commonly used 20 mg IV on day 1 (Dimopoulos DRC) must be VERIFIED against a cited dosing source.

drugs.name: Rituximab

provenance.source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22nd ed.

drugs.notes: Rituximab dose VALUE 375 mg/m2 sourced to Harrison 22nd ed. line 385777; in DRC it is given on day 1 of each cycle (standard scheduling). IgM FLARE CAUTION: rituximab can transiently raise serum IgM and worsen hyperviscosity - plasmapheresis before rituximab or withhold rituximab initially in high-IgM patients (Harrison line 126614; DeVita line 267632). Screen hepatitis B before rituximab (NCCN WM workup, extract line 215).

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: DOSE AND BASIS NOT ESTABLISHED IN THE PROVIDED SOURCES -> VERIFY (basis, dosePerUnit, and unit all VERIFY). Days 1 to 5 reflect the standard oral DRC schedule pending verification. The commonly used cyclophosphamide 100 mg/m2 PO twice daily on days 1 to 5 (Dimopoulos DRC) must be VERIFIED against a cited dosing source before use. DeVita reports DRC overall response ~83%, complete response ~7%, 2-year OS 81% and PFS 67% (line 267637 to 267638) but does not state the component doses.

premedications.name: Rituximab premedication
premedications.notes: acetaminophen and antihistamine per standard rituximab labeling

supportiveCare: Hepatitis B screening before rituximab - reactivation risk (NCCN WM workup, extract line 215).
Plasmapheresis before rituximab or initial rituximab withholding in high-IgM / hyperviscosity patients to avoid IgM flare (Harrison line 126614; DeVita line 267632).
Consider PJP/antimicrobial prophylaxis per institutional practice for cyclophosphamide/rituximab immunosuppression.

monitoring: CBC before each cycle - cyclophosphamide myelosuppression
Serum IgM / quantitative immunoglobulins and viscosity - IgM flare with rituximab
Hepatitis B viral status - reactivation with rituximab

doseModificationRules.text: Plasmapheresis before rituximab or withhold rituximab initially to prevent IgM-flare hyperviscosity (Harrison line 126614). Clinical review required.
Antiviral prophylaxis and monitoring per hepatitis B status before rituximab. Clinical review required.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: lines 267635 to 267639 (DRC = dexamethasone, rituximab, cyclophosphamide; overall response ~83%, CR ~7%, 2-yr OS 81% and PFS 67%; avoids bortezomib/thalidomide neuropathy); line 267632 (rituximab IgM flare)

core.source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22nd ed.
core.locator: line 385777 (rituximab 375 mg/m2 - dose value); line 126614 (rituximab IgM flare, plasmapheresis before rituximab); lines 126602 to 126604 (alkylators incl. cyclophosphamide plus rituximab first-line for symptomatic WM)

guideline.locator: Cyclophosphamide/Dexamethasone + Rituximab as a recommended regimen for primary (extract line 485) and previously treated disease (extract line 517); hepatitis B testing if rituximab planned (extract line 215)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for DRC (dexamethasone/rituximab/cyclophosphamide), a recommended non-neuropathic chemoimmunotherapy option for primary and previously treated Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia/LPL (DeVita: overall response ~83%). Regimen identity is grounded in Standard Guidelines (NCCN) WM v1.2027 (Cyclophosphamide/Dexamethasone + Rituximab, extract lines 485, 517) and DeVita 12th ed. (lines 267635 to 267639). The rituximab dose value (375 mg/m2) is sourced to Harrison 22nd ed. line 385777. The dexamethasone and cyclophosphamide DOSES are set to VERIFY (and cyclophosphamide basis and unit VERIFY): the provided sources describe the regimen and its efficacy but do not print the component doses, so dexamethasone 20 mg and cyclophosphamide 100 mg/m2 PO twice daily x5 (Dimopoulos DRC) are not asserted and must be verified; cycleLengthDays and cycles are likewise VERIFY. Hepatitis B screening before rituximab and the rituximab IgM-flare/hyperviscosity caution (plasmapheresis before rituximab) are captured. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
